sentences.ko: 있잖아, 모니카, 나 걱정해서 연락해준 거 진짜 고마운데, 나 지금은 많이 괜찮아졌어.
sentences.text: Look, Monica, I really appreciate you checking in on me, but I'm actually feeling a lot better.

alts.text: Hey Monica, thanks for checking in, but I'm doing so much better now.
I am truly grateful that you checked on me, Monica, but I am feeling much better now.

sentences.note: **checking in on me** 는 "내가 잘 지내나 살펴보다, 안부를 확인하다"라는 뜻이에요. 누가 걱정돼서 연락해 줬을 때 고마움을 표현하며 자주 씁니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones That Make You Laugh: Part 3 | Friends

sentences.ko: 어, 걔 얼마 전에 안데스산맥으로 넉 달 동안 트레킹 갔다가 막 돌아왔어.
sentences.text: Yeah, he just got back from like this four month trek in the Andes.

alts.text: So he's finally back — did this four-month trek through the Andes.
He recently returned from a four-month trekking trip in the Andes.

sentences.note: **just got back from** 은 "막 ~에서 돌아왔다"는 뜻으로 여행·출장 얘기할 때 정말 자주 쓰는 표현이에요. 캐주얼하게 말할 땐 문장 중간에 **like** 를 끼워 넣어서 말투를 부드럽게 만들기도 해요.
sentences.situation: The Ones That Make You Laugh: Part 3 | Friends

sentences.ko: 결혼 생활을 잘 유지하는 게 얼마나 힘든 일인지 넌 상상도 못 할 거야.
sentences.text: You have no idea what it takes to make a marriage work.

alts.text: Trust me, you have no clue how hard it is to keep a marriage going.
You cannot imagine how much effort is required to sustain a marriage.

sentences.note: **You have no idea what it takes to** 라는 표현은 "그게 얼마나 힘든 일인지 넌 전혀 모른다"는 뜻으로, 어떤 일의 노력이나 어려움을 강조하고 싶을 때 씁니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 5 | Friends

sentences.ko: 우리 다 같이 자리 좀 비켜주고 이 커플 둘이 있게 해주는 거 어때?
sentences.text: What do you say we all uh clear out of here and let these two love birds get back down to business?

alts.text: Why don't we all clear out and let these two love birds do their thing?
Perhaps we should all leave so that this couple can spend some time alone.

sentences.note: **clear out of here** 는 "자리를 비우다, 빠져나가다"라는 뜻이고, **love birds** 는 사이좋은 커플을 다정하게(또는 놀리듯) 부르는 말이에요. 커플만 남겨 두고 자리를 비켜줄 때 쓰기 좋아요.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 5 | Friends

sentences.ko: 그냥 하루 종일 목욕 가운 입고 땅콩 과자나 먹고 싶었어.
sentences.text: I wanted to wear my bathrobe and eat peanut clusters all day.

alts.text: Man, I just wanted to lounge around in my bathrobe eating peanut clusters all day.
What I truly wanted was to spend the whole day in my bathrobe eating peanut clusters.

sentences.note: **wear my bathrobe and eat peanut clusters all day** 처럼 "편한 옷 입고 하루 종일 뒹굴며 뭘 먹고 싶다"는 표현은 아무것도 안 하고 늘어지고 싶은 날을 얘기할 때 딱 좋은 말투예요.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 3 | Friends
